A=np.array([[0.,1.,0.],[1.,0.,1.],[0.,1.,0.]])
D=np.diag(A.sum(1));L=D-A
x=np.array([[1.,0.],[0.,1.],[2.,1.]])

G=(degree**-.5)[:,None]*B*(degree**-.5)[None,:]
print("Graph-Laplacian eigenvalues:",np.linalg.eigvalsh(L))
